# Покрытия этого определения провинции, посчитанные один раз и разложенные
# по всем её кускам.
#
# **Переменная на самом `province_definition` не читается обратно** -- это
# правило первой версии и то же делает CM: всё считается в локальных, а пишется
# в каждую провинцию определения (`every_province_in_province_definition`).
# Локация потом читает своё через `province = { var:... }`.
# Scope: province_definition

	set_local_variable = { name = gbeer_1 value = bag_wtp2_tr_opt1 }
	if = {
		limit = { bag_wtp2_tr_opt2 > local_var:gbeer_1 }

	set_local_variable = { name = gpottery_2 value = bag_wtp2_tr_opt175 }
	set_local_variable = { name = gtar_2 value = bag_wtp2_tr_opt177 }
	set_local_variable = { name = gtools_1 value = bag_wtp2_tr_opt178 }
	if = {
		limit = { bag_wtp2_tr_opt179 > local_var:gtools_1 }
		set_local_variable = { name = gtools_1 value = bag_wtp2_tr_opt179 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { bag_wtp2_tr_opt180 > local_var:gtools_1 }
		set_local_variable = { name = gtools_1 value = bag_wtp2_tr_opt180 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { bag_wtp2_tr_opt181 > local_var:gtools_1 }
		set_local_variable = { name = gtools_1 value = bag_wtp2_tr_opt181 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { bag_wtp2_tr_opt182 > local_var:gtools_1 }
		set_local_variable = { name = gtools_1 value = bag_wtp2_tr_opt182 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { bag_wtp2_tr_opt183 > local_var:gtools_1 }
		set_local_variable = { name = gtools_1 value = bag_wtp2_tr_opt183 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { bag_wtp2_tr_opt185 > local_var:gtools_1 }
		set_local_variable = { name = gtools_1 value = bag_wtp2_tr_opt185 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { bag_wtp2_tr_opt187 > local_var:gtools_1 }
		set_local_variable = { name = gtools_1 value = bag_wtp2_tr_opt187 }
	}
	set_local_variable = { name = gtools_2 value = bag_wtp2_tr_opt184 }
	set_local_variable = { name = gtools_3 value = bag_wtp2_tr_opt186 }
	set_local_variable = { name = gweaponry_1 value = bag_wtp2_tr_opt188 }
	if = {
		limit = { bag_wtp2_tr_opt189 > local_var:gweaponry_1 }
		set_local_variable = { name = gweaponry_1 value = bag_wtp2_tr_opt189 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { bag_wtp2_tr_opt190 > local_var:gweaponry_1 }
		set_local_variable = { name = gweaponry_1 value = bag_wtp2_tr_opt190 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { bag_wtp2_tr_opt191 > local_var:gweaponry_1 }
		set_local_variable = { name = gweaponry_1 value = bag_wtp2_tr_opt191 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { bag_wtp2_tr_opt192 > local_var:gweaponry_1 }
		set_local_variable = { name = gweaponry_1 value = bag_wtp2_tr_opt192 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { bag_wtp2_tr_opt193 > local_var:gweaponry_1 }
		set_local_variable = { name = gweaponry_1 value = bag_wtp2_tr_opt193 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { bag_wtp2_tr_opt195 > local_var:gweaponry_1 }
		set_local_variable = { name = gweaponry_1 value = bag_wtp2_tr_opt195 }
	}
	set_local_variable = { name = gweaponry_2 value = bag_wtp2_tr_opt194 }
	set_local_variable = { name = gweaponry_3 value = bag_wtp2_tr_opt196 }
	set_local_variable = { name = gwine_1 value = bag_wtp2_tr_opt197 }
	if = {
		limit = { bag_wtp2_tr_opt198 > local_var:gwine_1 }
		set_local_variable = { name = gwine_1 value = bag_wtp2_tr_opt198 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { bag_wtp2_tr_opt199 > local_var:gwine_1 }
		set_local_variable = { name = gwine_1 value = bag_wtp2_tr_opt199 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { bag_wtp2_tr_opt200 > local_var:gwine_1 }
		set_local_variable = { name = gwine_1 value = bag_wtp2_tr_opt200 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { bag_wtp2_tr_opt201 > local_var:gwine_1 }
		set_local_variable = { name = gwine_1 value = bag_wtp2_tr_opt201 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { bag_wtp2_tr_opt202 > local_var:gwine_1 }
		set_local_variable = { name = gwine_1 value = bag_wtp2_tr_opt202 }
	}

	every_province_in_province_definition = {
		set_variable = { name = bag_wtp2_tr_c_beer value = local_var:gbeer_1 }
		set_variable = { name = bag_wtp2_tr_c_books value = local_var:gbooks_1 }
		set_variable = { name = bag_wtp2_tr_c_cannons value = local_var:gcannons_1 }
		set_variable = { name = bag_wtp2_tr_c_cloth value = local_var:gcloth_1 }
		set_variable = { name = bag_wtp2_tr_c_dyes value = local_var:gdyes_1 }
		set_variable = { name = bag_wtp2_tr_c_fine_cloth value = local_var:gfine_cloth_1 }
		set_variable = { name = bag_wtp2_tr_c_firearms value = local_var:gfirearms_1 }
		set_variable = { name = bag_wtp2_tr_c_furniture value = local_var:gfurniture_1 }
		set_variable = { name = bag_wtp2_tr_c_glass value = local_var:gglass_1 }
		set_variable = { name = bag_wtp2_tr_c_glass_g2 value = local_var:gglass_2 }
		set_variable = { name = bag_wtp2_tr_c_jewelry value = local_var:gjewelry_1 }
		set_variable = { name = bag_wtp2_tr_c_jewelry_g2 value = local_var:gjewelry_2 }
		set_variable = { name = bag_wtp2_tr_c_leather value = local_var:gleather_1 }
		set_variable = { name = bag_wtp2_tr_c_leather_g2 value = local_var:gleather_2 }
		set_variable = { name = bag_wtp2_tr_c_liquor value = local_var:gliquor_1 }
		set_variable = { name = bag_wtp2_tr_c_masonry value = local_var:gmasonry_1 }
		set_variable = { name = bag_wtp2_tr_c_masonry_g2 value = local_var:gmasonry_2 }
		set_variable = { name = bag_wtp2_tr_c_naval_supplies value = local_var:gnaval_supplies_1 }
		set_variable = { name = bag_wtp2_tr_c_naval_supplies_g2 value = local_var:gnaval_supplies_2 }
		set_variable = { name = bag_wtp2_tr_c_paper value = local_var:gpaper_1 }
		set_variable = { name = bag_wtp2_tr_c_pottery value = local_var:gpottery_1 }
		set_variable = { name = bag_wtp2_tr_c_pottery_g2 value = local_var:gpottery_2 }
		set_variable = { name = bag_wtp2_tr_c_tar_g2 value = local_var:gtar_2 }
		set_variable = { name = bag_wtp2_tr_c_tools value = local_var:gtools_1 }
		set_variable = { name = bag_wtp2_tr_c_tools_g2 value = local_var:gtools_2 }
		set_variable = { name = bag_wtp2_tr_c_tools_g3 value = local_var:gtools_3 }
		set_variable = { name = bag_wtp2_tr_c_weaponry value = local_var:gweaponry_1 }
		set_variable = { name = bag_wtp2_tr_c_weaponry_g2 value = local_var:gweaponry_2 }
		set_variable = { name = bag_wtp2_tr_c_weaponry_g3 value = local_var:gweaponry_3 }
		set_variable = { name = bag_wtp2_tr_c_wine value = local_var:gwine_1 }
	}
}

# Лучшее право этой локации. Считается после того, как покрытия разложены.
# Ноль по всем девяти -- переменных не остаётся вовсе, и карта такую локацию не
# красит: «этой земле ни одно право ничего не даёт» -- это ответ, а не пустота.
# Scope: location
bag_wtp2_tr_score_location = {
	set_local_variable = { name = enc value = bag_wtp2_tr_enc9 }
	if = {
		limit = { bag_wtp2_tr_enc8 > local_var:enc }
		set_local_variable = { name = enc value = bag_wtp2_tr_enc8 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { bag_wtp2_tr_enc7 > local_var:enc }
		set_local_variable = { name = enc value = bag_wtp2_tr_enc7 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { bag_wtp2_tr_enc6 > local_var:enc }
		set_local_variable = { name = enc value = bag_wtp2_tr_enc6 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { bag_wtp2_tr_enc5 > local_var:enc }
		set_local_variable = { name = enc value = bag_wtp2_tr_enc5 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { bag_wtp2_tr_enc4 > local_var:enc }
		set_local_variable = { name = enc value = bag_wtp2_tr_enc4 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { bag_wtp2_tr_enc3 > local_var:enc }
		set_local_variable = { name = enc value = bag_wtp2_tr_enc3 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { bag_wtp2_tr_enc2 > local_var:enc }
		set_local_variable = { name = enc value = bag_wtp2_tr_enc2 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { bag_wtp2_tr_enc1 > local_var:enc }
		set_local_variable = { name = enc value = bag_wtp2_tr_enc1 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { local_var:enc >= 10 }
		set_variable = {
			name = bag_wtp2_tr_best_idx
			value = { value = local_var:enc modulo = 10 }
		}
		set_variable = {
			name = bag_wtp2_tr_best_mil
			value = {
				value = local_var:enc
				subtract = var:bag_wtp2_tr_best_idx
				divide = 10
			}
		}
	}
	else = {
		remove_variable = bag_wtp2_tr_best_idx
		remove_variable = bag_wtp2_tr_best_mil
	}
}
